rationale: All runs are setup-limited at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC on reg-to-reg paths at 8.59 ns; hold (+0.09 ns, 0 hold buffers), slew/cap (0 vs bar 295) and DRC never bind. With ~1.9 ns slack timing repair idles (round 3's runs differed in margins/cap% yet matched exactly), so T_eff is the natural path. The orfs/AREA 3/ABC buffering+sizing/routability recipe owns every top run, and compaction helped (density 32->43->55%: 7.03->6.92->6.68 ns). Routed wire runs ~11% over estimate and max-RC limits, so shrink the die: util 32, density 58%, slew 40 kept. Pin post-GRT timing with a 0.35 ns margin so the winner's re-runs at tighter clocks repair and pass.
